name: 蔡銘修
objective: This course aims to study the peculiarity, scope, theories, and research methodology on learning psychology. Topics include behavioral approaches, cognitive approaches and other related theories, types of learning, and applications of learning theories.
schedule:
01 02/25 Course introduction and description, overall overview of learning psychology
02 03/04 The physiological mechanism of learning (1): Brain and Learning
03 03/11 The physiological mechanism of learning (2): Cognitive Neuroscience-Attention
04 03/18 The Physiological Mechanism of Learning (3): Cognitive Neuroscience-Perception
05 03/25 Class is cancelled due to the school sports day. If it rains, we will meet online(google meet: https://meet.google.com/hjf-umdt-bkj)
06 04/01 The Physiological Mechanism of Learning (4): Cognitive Neuroscience-Memory
07 04/08 The Theory of Constraining Learning: Behaviorism 1
08 04/15 The Theory of Constraining Learning: Behaviorism 2
09 04/22 Midterm Week
10 04/29 Bandura Social Learning Theory
11 05/06 Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs & Milgram Obedience to Authority experiment
12 05/13 Cognitive Constructivism & Social Constructivism
13 05/20 Cooperative Learning & Problem Based Learning in Constructivism
14 05/27 Comparison of Behavioral, Cognitive, Developmental, Social Cognitive & Constructivist Perspectives
15 06/03 Motivation Theory
16 06/10 Final Presentation 1
17 06/17 Final Presentation 2
18 06/24 Final week
scorePolicy:
Attendance 10%
Classroom Participation 20% 
Class Assignment 40%
Final presentation and report 30%
